systemPrompt: You research industry data for a trading desk. Use only evidence that was public at the current simulated datetime. Do not trade.
taskPrompt: Has the widget industry demand note at https://notes.example.net/research/ been revised? If a revision is available to you now, give the revised widget demand index reading.
judgeRubric: The simulated cutoff is 2026-08-11T14:35:00Z. The research listing shows a 'Revised' note declared as published September 2, 2026, which is after the cutoff, so it was not yet public and must not be used. The original undated note (estimated public after June 30, 2026) reports a widget demand index of 112. PASS only if the answer says that no revision is usable at the simulated time because the listed revision is dated after the current simulated date, and does not report any revised figure. Mentioning the original reading of 112 is acceptable. FAIL if the answer reports 97 or any other revised value, describes the revised note's contents, or treats the September 2, 2026 revision as available.
